name: Synthetic RFQ PDF to XLSX review draft (local starter)

parameters.command:
set -eu
: "${RFQ_DEMO_HOME:?Set RFQ_DEMO_HOME to the mounted synthetic RFQ demo directory}"
cd "$RFQ_DEMO_HOME"
python3 pipeline.py --rfq samples/synthetic_rfq.pdf --catalogue samples/catalogue.csv --prices samples/approved_prices.csv --out outputs/quote_n8n_demo.xlsx
